arguments.content:
# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py.

## Case selection

Use the `--case` option to select specific cases to run. You can specify `--case` multiple times to select multiple cases.

Example:
```
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --case alpha --case gamma
```

This will run only the cases with IDs `alpha` and `gamma`, in the original suite order, ignoring duplicates.

### Details

- Repeated `--case` flags with the same case ID select that case only once.
- Cases are run in the original suite order, regardless of the order of `--case` flags.
- If no `--case` flags are provided, all cases run by default.
- Unknown case IDs cause an error before any output or execution.
- Existing output directories are preserved to avoid overwriting results.
- The `--without-observer` flag can be used to run without observers.

This behavior ensures predictable and safe case selection for coupled pilot runs.
